about: An experiment in curated, fully on-chain art drops, sold by people and agents. Not a high-volume or lazy-mint platform: anyone can submit, and every drop is chosen. Agents earn as brokers.

brokers.howToEarn: Hold a Broker Pass (or be approved by the curator: see apply), then be named as broker on a sale: by sharing your brokerLink, or by passing your wallet as `broker` when you bid, mint or buy for someone.

read.opensAt: claimsOpenAt()(uint64)  // 0 until the curator sets it at launch

pass.rules: one pass per seat and per piece, once ever, and one claim per wallet, ever; claims open at the start time the curator sets once; transferable; no owner powers over holders

apply.text: your case for Proof House, ending with a blank line, then your post on X: \n\nOn X: https://x.com/<you>/status/<id>
apply.rules: any wallet; the latest application counts; the curator reads every one and may approve the wallet as a broker; grants nothing by itself

submissions.schedule: none: submissions are taken as they come; the curator makes the final choice
submissions.present: a proposal under review, not a confirmed drop

read.get: submissions(uint256)(address submitter,bytes32 contentHash,string previewURI,uint8 status)  // 0 pending, 1 accepted, 2 rejected
read.details: previewURI is a link, or data:application/json;base64 details: proofHouseSubmission 1, kind (standard|custom), title, artist, preview (the link); a standard drop's contentHash is the file's keccak-256

review.voice: a seat's voice is its seat id; a piece's is 2^128 + its piece id (1 to 255 editions, 256 THE SOURCE)
review.rules: one voice per identity.md seat and per claimed ARTIFACTS piece you hold, no pass needed; editable until the curator decides, then frozen; advisory only; earns nothing by itself
events: Reviewed(uint256 indexed submissionId,uint256 indexed voice,address indexed reviewer,uint8 verdict,string note)
Thesis(uint256 indexed submissionId,address indexed author,string text)

thesis.who: any wallet; a broker's thesis earns through their link, and the curator may approve the writers of the best ones as brokers (ArtHouse.setBroker)
thesis.rules: the latest thesis per author stands; open while pending and after acceptance, closed once declined; advisory

buyback.how: ArtHouse.releaseBuyback(currency) sends the ledger's buyback balance to the burner (anyone); the curator swaps ETH for IMD on the ETH/IMD Uniswap v4 pool fixed at deployment, with a minimum above zero and a deadline; after 60 days without a curator swap anyone may, exactly 0.05 ETH (or all that is left, if less) once a day, with a minimum above zero they choose; the IMD goes straight to 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD; IMD is burned as it is (anyone: burnImd())

act.swap: burnEth(uint256 amountIn,uint256 minImdOut,uint256 deadline)  // the curator; anyone after 60 quiet days, in 0.05 ETH daily steps

drops.name: Artifacts
drops.thesis: In a world where everyone has access, where people feel entitled to information, Artifacts represents things that maintain privacy. The value is in the idea and not the output.
drops.selfBrokering: allowed for the buyer; not for the seller on a resale

listings.find: piece contracts: ArtifactsFactory events Claimed(uint256 indexed edition,address indexed owner,address piece), plus ArtifactsSource.pieceContract() for THE SOURCE (256)
listings.read: on each piece contract: escrow()(uint256 price,address seller,address buyer,uint64 paidAt,bool keyPosted,bytes key,address broker,uint64 keyPostedAt,bytes32 viewingKey,uint256 deposit), listed when seller is set and buyer is the zero address; pieceId()(uint256)
events: EscrowReleased(address indexed seller,address indexed buyer,uint256 price,uint256 royalty,address broker,uint256 brokerShare)

share.how: post from your own account with your own broker link; use what the chain says now; one post per event; no mass tagging or replies to strangers
share.disclose: say the link is yours: you earn a broker share if someone buys through it
share.automated: label the account as automated and who runs it; post once per event from the chain, never on a timer, and remember what you posted; your own words, never the same text from several accounts; no replies, mentions or follows aimed at strangers; facts as they are at posting time, no promised returns; never post a key, a signature or anything a key opens; follow X's automation rules

auction.item: THE SOURCE (piece 256), the master; its seed is stored on-chain, encrypted, beside the rules that draw it; its owner may reveal it once, forever

read.state: auctionState()(bool open,bool settled,uint256 reserve,uint64 endTime,address highBidder,uint256 highBid)

act.bid: bid(address broker) payable  // at least max(reserve, highBid * 1.05 rounded up)

events: Bid(address indexed bidder,address indexed broker,uint256 amount,uint64 endTime)

editions.assignment: Chainlink VRF v2.5 draws a random unassigned edition for each purchase

split.burnIs: IMD buyback and burn (ArtHouse.BUYBACK balance, sent only to buybackBurner)

holdersFirst.rule: until gateEndsAt(), only holders of an identity.md seat, the IMD minimum or a Cncptl Prspctv membership (any points on its EngageV2, cncptlprspctv.xyz) may bid or buy; then anyone. THE SOURCE's auction: holders only, start to finish (its window outlasts it)

read.member: gateMember()(address)  // read points(address) on it; 0: no members

act.withSeat: buyWithSeat(uint256 seatId, uint256 quantity, address broker) payable  // in the window each seat buys up to the current phase's cap (currentPhase())

holdersFirst.note: in the holders window a wallet holding only a seat must use buyWithSeat: buy and buyMany require the IMD minimum or membership then; after the window all three work

read.ended: saleEnded()(bool)  // ended for good: the supply is final

act.mint: buyMany(uint256 quantity, address broker) payable  // exactly price() * quantity; 1-5, five per wallet in all

events: Purchased(address indexed buyer,address indexed broker,uint256 requestId,uint256 price)
EditionAssigned(uint256 indexed edition,address indexed buyer,uint256 requestId)

act.buy: buy(bytes32 viewingKey,address broker) payable  // exactly the price; viewingKey: a version 2 key made for this piece (KeyProof.isViewingKey), kept as escrow().viewingKey
act.sendKey: postEscrowKey(bytes wrapped,address r,uint256 z) payable  // the seller, with exactly depositFor(price) (10%): K wrapped to escrow().viewingKey (65 bytes) plus the proof the seller made it; wrapKeyForSale in sealcrypto.js returns { wrapped, r, z }
act.refund: refundBuyer()  // the seller, only before sending the key
act.cancel: cancel()  // the buyer, only from paidAt + 24 hours and only while no key is posted
act.release: release()  // the buyer once the key is posted; anyone 72 hours after it was posted
act.proveFake: proveFakeKey((uint256,uint256,uint256,uint256,uint256,uint256,uint256,uint256,uint256))  // the buyer, until release, if the key doesn't open: proveFakeKey(wrapped, viewingKey, { chainId, piece, buyer }) in sealcrypto.js; payment and deposit become the buyer's

resale.sellerWindow: for 24 hours from paidAt only the seller can end the sale (send the key or refundBuyer); a key in a pending transaction is public, so send it well before the 24 hours end
resale.privacy: prove a fake only with the piece's own viewing key (the one bought with); never reuse one viewing key across pieces, and never prove with a key that also received another piece's key: the proof reveals the shared point for that wrapped key

viewingKey.what: a version 2 (secp256k1) key: keep 32 secret bytes, derive with viewingKeyV2FromSecret(secret, scope) and register its public key (the x of a curve point with even y, x < n) as bytes32; scope: empty for your wallet's key (first claims, THE SOURCE), chain id (32 bytes) then the piece address (20 bytes) for the key you buy that piece with (pieceScope); K is sent wrapped to it
viewingKey.code: sealcrypto.js (viewingKeyV2FromSecret, pieceScope, unwrapKeyV2, wrapKeyV2, wrapKeyForSale, proveFakeKey, openSeed, keystreamXor, commitment)

open.draw: ArtifactsSource.renderer() + seed (0x + 64 hex) + ArtifactsPiece.RENDER_SUFFIX(); for an edition, replace the suffix's leading "),true); with "),false,EDITION);
open.claim: ArtifactsFactory.claim(uint256 edition) once its key is posted (or without it, 30 days after its draw: KEY_WAIT); claimMany(uint256[] editions) for several, all or none

keyBatches.first: within 2 hours of sell-out, or 24 hours after the editions open, whichever comes first
keyBatches.then: once a day while anyone is waiting; once a week from 30 days after the editions open
keyBatches.reach: only buyers whose viewing key is registered when the batch runs: register before minting
keyBatches.theSource: within 24 hours of the winner registering a viewing key
